page.overview:
Who is Viltrumincible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)}}

Viltrumincible is a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe, who embraced his Viltrumite heritage with ruthless loyalty.

Viltrumincible was assembled by Angstrom Levy to help start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension. After the war, he and the surviving variants turned on Angstrom for breaking their deal and were subsequently banished to the Wasteland Universe.

Viltrumincible has nearly identical physique to his original counterpart. He is tall and fair-skinned. There are several differences, though subtle, that reflect his divergent path, his hair features slightly longer bangs, and he lacks the pronounced eye bags of his counterpart.
